ExpertView.description: Someone to ask, with the visible evidence why. Not a ranking or a score.

rule.title: Rule
rule.default: Settled: the new holder is recorded, the responsibility was reviewed or shows recorded activity since they took it on, and the case's tasks for it are closed. Check in: 14 days without a review or any recorded activity, or open tasks past due. Activity counts events from any source and any person: this checks that the work is moving, not who did it.
